rules.problem: Plain 'Nasal discharge' (runny nose) is never asked: the list has Nasal congestion, Bleeding from nose and only 'Recurrent' nasal discharge, yet the common cold, acute viral infection, sinusitis and postnasal-drip rules all use plain Nasal discharge, and postnasal drip needs it ('Runny nose with persistent cough'). Add (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Nasal discharge" "finding")).

rules.rule: Diagnose possible diphtheria from nose symptoms
rules.problem: Structure (sore throat AND mild fever AND pseudomembrane nose OR throat) and 'possible' match 'consider diphtheria'. Mild fever could use 'Low grade pyrexia'.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable common cold from nose symptoms
rules.problem: Logic matches the 'No' branch, but '<3 days' is encoded with <= (house example for 'within last 3 days' uses <). Also needs a recorded temperature < 38 to fire; acceptable since temperature is routine.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable acute viral infection from nose symptoms
rules.problem: Matches the 'Yes' branch (any of temp >=38, chills, nausea, sore muscles); only the <= vs < boundary on '<3 days' is off.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable sinusitis from nose symptoms
rules.problem: 'Headache worse on bending forward' reduced to plain Headache, so the discriminating sinus feature is lost. The AND of all three features is a strict but defensible reading of the page box.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable allergic rhinitis from nose symptoms
rules.problem: '> 4 weeks' encoded as >= and 'most days' dropped; otherwise the OR of sneezing/itchy/runny/blocked nose and 'probable' match 'Allergic rhinitis likely'.

rules.rule: Diagnose probable postnasal drip from nose symptoms
Diagnose possible allergic rhinitis from nosebleed
Urgent: nose symptoms with head injury and clear watery nasal discharge
rules.problem: Urgent fits 'Give urgent attention… Refer urgently'. Clear+Watery nasal discharge follows the page wording (the page doesn't name CSF rhinorrhoea).

summary: Nothing is invented and every diagnosis has the right certainty. The most consequential gap: plain runny nose (Nasal discharge) is used by four diagnosis rules but is missing from the check_for task. Sinusitis drops 'worse on bending forward' from the headache, and the duration boundaries are off by one ('<3 days' as <=, '>4 weeks' as >=, 'most days' dropped). 'Mild fever' could use Low grade pyrexia.
